jobs.jobDescription:
This Staff Product Designer position at Heap (now part of Contentsquare) is centered on leading the experience strategy and vision for AI-native product surfaces. The role requires shaping the product roadmap in collaboration with Product Management, focusing on analytical or workflow tools within B2B SaaS. A key aspect involves designing user experiences from the underlying data model, considering how memory and context persist across sessions and surface to users. The designer will be responsible for setting the quality standard for AI-generated output, ensuring trustworthiness and effectiveness, and collaborating with engineering on customer-facing agentic workflows. Additionally, the role involves partnering with other designers working on AI features to review work, push thinking, and mentor less-senior team members. It is a virtual-first company with hybrid and remote work policies available.

**Core Responsibilities:**
*   Lead the experience strategy and vision for AI-powered product surfaces, influencing the product roadmap alongside product management.
*   Design user experiences from the data model upwards, considering data persistence and context across user sessions.
*   Define the quality standards for AI-generated output, focusing on trust, effectiveness, and evaluation with engineering.
*   Partner with engineering on agentic workflows and ensuring the trust and versioning of AI-generated output.
*   Collaborate with other designers on AI-native products, providing feedback and mentorship.
*   Drive zero-to-one work in ambiguous problem spaces, demonstrating a clear link to business outcomes.
*   Facilitate collaboration across engineering, product management, and design to reach shared decisions.

**Key Requirements:**
*   Staff-level product design experience, predominantly in B2B SaaS, particularly in analytics or workflow tools dealing with complex information.
*   Proven hands-on experience in shipping AI or agentic features, such as chat interfaces, generative output, personalization, and human-AI trust patterns.
*   Ability to understand and reason about the underlying data model of an interface.
*   Extensive track record of delivering 0-to-1 work in ambiguous problem spaces with clear business impact.
*   Strong collaboration and facilitation skills to align cross-functional teams.
*   Experience with user research, interaction design, prototyping, and visual design.
*   Proficiency in modern design tools.

*   Minimum of 7 years of relevant design experience, specifically working on B2B/enterprise software products, ideally targeting developers or highly technical users.
*   A strong portfolio demonstrating effective designs for complex products delivered in fast-paced settings.
*   Proven experience in conducting qualitative research within intricate technical fields.

*   Strong, proactive remote communication, collaboration, facilitation, and relationship-building skills.
*   Acute attention to detail and a willingness to learn about highly complex and technical product spaces.
*   Experience thriving in a fully-remote, fast-paced environment that values transparency, autonomy, and open sharing.
*   Prior domain knowledge or experience related to observability, cloud infrastructure, and/or database monitoring is a valuable asset.
